title: Nextflow pipeline parameters
description: A Nextflow workflow to execute the MICE synteny block computation tool, with the option to execute ggcat and gfa2gff to prepare MICE input. The JSON Schema was initially built using the nf-core pipeline schema builder, then edited manually.

input_graph_gff.description: Path to MICE input graph file in .gff format
input_graph_gff.help_text: Use this if you already have a correctly-formatted GFF graph, and do not need to construct one using ggcat. Incompatible with `input_fasta_dir`.

input_fasta_dir.description: Path to directory containing FASTA files for use with ggcat (DBG generation) or gfa2gff (GFA to GFF format conversion)
input_fasta_dir.help_text:
This option is only to be used when running `ggcat` or `gfa2gff` to prepare the input file for MICE. If running MICE directly, omit this option.
Please ensure only FASTA files (permitted file endings: .fa, .fa.gz, .fna, .fna.gz, .fasta, .fasta.gz) are present in this directory.

out_dir.description: Path to directory in which MICE will write its output files

execution_options.title: Execution Options
execution_options.description: Options to change the execution of the tool. For more information on the function of each parameter, see the Usage tab.

remove_dup.description: Remove an element if it occurs at least X times in any genome. 0 = disable.

quorum.description: Minimum number of genomes an element must appear in to be kept. 0 = disable.

min_size.description: After first compression, drop unmerged elements shorter than X base pairs, then compress again. 0 = disable.

no_group_by.description: If true, every path is treated as its own genome.

merge_with_dup.description: Avoid marking duplicated elements in each genome and merge them as if they were unique.

k.description: Size of `k` for ggcat/gfa2gff graph building.
